title: SuiteSparseQR：最小平方殘差與秩虧解辨識
titleEn: SuiteSparseQR: least-squares residuals and rank-deficient solutions
subcategoryTitle: 數值求解器的可靠性與證明
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「SuiteSparseQR：最小平方殘差與秩虧解辨識」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付矩陣與殘差、正交性證明、變更觀測結果及相依欄反例。
summaryEn: Investigate SuiteSparseQR: least-squares residuals and rank-deficient solutions using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver matrix and residual calculations, orthogonality evidence, changed-observation results and a dependent-column counterexample separating fitted predictions from coefficient uniqueness.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「觀測方程可解性」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Inspect observation compatibility: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 零殘差要求可能本來就不合理；秩判定又可能受尺度與容許值影響，不能把成功旗標當成唯一性證明。
接受時同時檢查殘差正交、秩與資料模型；較小殘差不自動代表對含噪資料的泛化更好。
過定系統通常無法使所有殘差為零；以可手算最小平方問題區分最佳殘差、精確解與秩虧。
optionsEn: Demanding zero residual may be inappropriate for the data. Rank decisions can depend on scaling and tolerance, so a solver success flag alone does not prove coefficient uniqueness.
Acceptance checks residual orthogonality, rank and the data model together. A smaller training residual does not automatically establish better generalization for noisy observations.
An overdetermined system need not admit zero residual. A hand-solvable least-squares fixture separates an optimal residual from an exact solution and from uniqueness under rank deficiency.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。過定系統通常無法使所有殘差為零；以可手算最小平方問題區分最佳殘差、精確解與秩虧。 與本階段判準一起判讀：基線無精確解，最小平方問題仍有明確意義。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. An overdetermined system need not admit zero residual. A hand-solvable least-squares fixture separates an optimal residual from an exact solution and from uniqueness under rank deficiency. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: The baseline has no exact solution, but its least-squares problem remains well defined.
